text:
rachel: FYI support flagged another billing-spike when tenants enabled the v2 canary. The root cause looks like route fallback events being counted separately in the UX.
tom: Yep. We currently emit handshake/decision/response events and some dashboards index the handshake which inflates counts.
jules: Proposal: emit one canonical field on the final response event, `served_variant`, that billing and analytics should prefer. Keep handshake/decision events for debug only with `debug=true`.
infra-bot: note: changing ingestion filters requires a canary so historical exports aren't inadvertently altered.
console-pm: From console side we want: (1) single billed-tokens view per logical route, (2) fallback % over time, (3) an "estimate impact" preview for flips.
tom: Implementation sketch: router adds `served_variant` string (flattened) and `served_meta` object (debug blob). Ingestion maps `served_variant` -> billing column; debug consumers keep served_meta.
rachel: Also need sampling for handshake events. My suggestion: adaptive sampling: small tenants (<10rps) keep 100%, large tenants get 1% handshake sampling while rollout active.
jules: Deterministic sampling in router: hash(tenant_id + rollout_id) < threshold. That keeps samples stable across retries.
console-pm: For the preview card, we'll use 30d token histogram and per-token model rates. Show a confidence band and mark as "estimate" until canonical field stabilizes histograms.
infra-bot: Canary plan: deploy emitted fields to staging, enable ingestion transform to compute legacy vs canonical totals for 48h. If diffs < 0.2% for top tenants, proceed.
tom: Action items: 1) Router: add `served_variant` + sampling hook (tom/jules) 2) Ingestion: prefer served_variant for billing, retain debug stream (rachel/infra) 3) Console: add estimate card + experimental raw-events toggle (console-pm).
rachel: Timeline: router PR this week, ingestion changes next week, staging 48h canary in 2 weeks.
console-pm: I'll mock the UI now and label it low-confidence until telemetry is fixed.
jules: I'll add a short migration note for support docs. tagging: @tom @rachel @console-pm. :thumbsup:
